a4MicroSystemShiFuMi.setDiscServoAngle: Sets the angle of the disc servomotor connected to S0.
a4MicroSystemShiFuMi.ultrasonicDistanceC: Reads the distance measured by the ultrasonic sensor on P2. Returns -1 when no echo is received.
a4MicroSystemShiFuMi.handDetected: Returns true when a hand is detected below the selected distance.
a4MicroSystemShiFuMi.setDiscBacklightBri: Sets the brightness of the RGB backlight located below the disc.
a4MicroSystemShiFuMi.setDiscBacklightCol: Sets the RGB backlight located below the disc to a predefined color.
color used by the disc backlight
a4MicroSystemShiFuMi.setDiscBacklightRgb: Sets a custom RGB color for the backlight located below the disc.
a4MicroSystemShiFuMi.discBacklightOff: Turns off the RGB backlight located below the disc.
a4MicroSystemShiFuMi.lcdInit: Initializes the Grove RGB LCD screen.
a4MicroSystemShiFuMi.lcdShowTextLine: Displays text on one line of the LCD screen. Text longer than 16 characters is truncated.
a4MicroSystemShiFuMi.lcdShowNumberLine: Displays a number on one line of the LCD screen.
a4MicroSystemShiFuMi.lcdSetBacklightColo: Sets the LCD backlight to a predefined color.
color used by the LCD backlight
a4MicroSystemShiFuMi.lcdSetBacklightRgb: Sets a custom RGB color for the LCD backlight.
